company_info.company_description: "Our services range from residential installations through to commercial and agricultural systems. Our qualified electricians will visit your home or business before installation, so you know you're getting the solar panels and electrical services that are right for you.Our systems are customised to fit each customer. We supply and install high quality products with outstanding efficiency and warranties that will ensure great savings in the short term as well as in the years to come.We work hard to support you through every step in your solar journey, providing ongoing solar checks, maintenance and cleaning services.Why should you choose us?We’ve customised and installed systems ranging from 1.5kW up to 100kW.We’re a locally owned solar company with a Toowoomba based warehouse and office.We use employees trained to the Proven standard, not subcontractors.You can meet the friendly people who will take care of your system in person.Count on quality that lasts, with an established companyChat with an installer, not a pushy sales company working on commission."

reviews.review_description: No notes. All services were provided professionally and quickly, despite issues with my energy service provider that were outside of Proven's control

After deciding to investigate a solar installation for our home we asked six companies to provide us with a recommendation and a quote. Right at the outset we decided to attempt to give our preference to a local company even though three of the companies we contacted were not local. Proven Energy was the first to respond and we found their consultant to be friendly, genuine and prompt. Without criticising any of the others who contacted us we eventually decided upon Proven Energy with whom to do business and we were not disappointed. Communication to us by them was excellent as we progressed, and appointments, visits etc. were prompt and professional. we have now only to have a smart meter installed by our power provider and then all systems will be go. My assessment of the installation by Proven Energy indicates that it is a quality system and the workmanship appears to be exemplary. I congratulate them on their approach to business and have no hesitation in recommending them for consideration to anyone thinking of going solar.

Sales team were proactive contacting me. They were knowledgeable on the products and willing to spend the time with me to explain the system options they had quoted.Installation was great. The installation team were professional and got the installation completed quickly and to a high standard. The team had managed to organise grid connection for same day as installation.Highly reccomnded this solar supplier.

We are very satisfied with our choice of materials and the quality of the installation by Proven Energy. It took 5 weeks from accepting the quote and paying the deposit to having the REC panels and Fronius inverter installed and working. There were a couple of minor hiccups in communication along the way, but these were resolved promptly. The installers were helpful and reliable.Proven submitted the paperwork to Ergon Energy for connection to the grid, but Ergon took 2 weeks to make the connection.
Polite and punctual. Professional and helpful when installing solar panels Admin staff courteous & informative.

Sales was good, really pushed for the sale and tried to be competitive on price.Everything fell apart once I paid deposit. I had to follow up with them after waiting 2 weeks after paying my deposit as I had not heard anything. I hadn’t received confirmation that my deposit was paid or what the next steps were.From there we had a number of further communication issues from the company, but after 5 weeks and a number phone calls I had an installation date.Installation has happened and I believe they did a good job installing the system. The system works well although they did not configure my catch controller so they need to return again to finish that off.

I chose Proven Energy to remove my old system and install the new one as they took the time to explain the process so I could understand all my options, the quoting and sales process was straightforward to follow. They treated me professionally, courteously, and in a friendly manner at all times.The installation process was able to be booked on a day that I was able to have time off work, and the installation workmen were punctual, polite, and courteous, and walked me through what I needed to know about the system's functionality. The company organized everything from start to finish as well as the communication with the power company and connection to the grid.

The sales quoting process was very simple. Quotes were received promptly and very easy to understand and compare. The quote included two choices which I found helpful.The installation crew arrived at the designated time and were very polite. They explained what needed to happen and discussed placement of inverter. All bits and pieces and scraps were picked up and binned leaving all areas as they were. Any questions I had were answered and explained in a friendly manner.The sales person I dealt with who helped me make my decision was very easy to talk to and made me feel very comfortable from the first visit to the last phone call.  They did organise the grid connection and explained what to expect when they came.
Fast installation, great communication. Sales rep was thorough, polite, and professional. Would recommend.

Overall dealing with Proven energy was hassle free and an easy process.Josh was more than happy to help and provide more than one quote on different solution depending on your situation or expectations.From Sales, admin to installer, all parties involved were professional and helpful.The time between accepting quote and start of installation was alot quicker than expected, so no complaints there.The only negative point i have for the whole experience is the loss of power for six hours, due to the main fuse at the front of the property not being installed properly (as advised by energex). Proven energy were very apologetic and have offered to cover the bill if one is received,I will be referring Proven energy to other. For now, the proof is in the pudding.
Can't fault the service so far.  The salesman seemed quite knowledgeable and didn't try to upsell me on products I didn't need.  Install was well organised and executed despite bad weather.
Proven Energy (Jaime Marschke) came to the rescue when the original installer was unable to help.

Jaime Marschke from Proven Energy came to the rescue when my system encountered a hiccup. The original installers weren't able to provide immediate assistance but Proven Energy were happy to step in and solve the issue.
Our solar system has saved us heaps with our electricity bills. It gives me a lot of comfort knowing it’s up there, insulating is from rising energy rates.

The Proven Energy Sales person was easy to talk with and provided the information in an easy to understand manner. The quote was detailed and easy to digest and make comparisons. I was told we could have an installation in 3 weeks after paying a deposit. It took over 5 weeks for the installation to happen.The contractors doing the install drilled through the roof and into our ceilings. This caused some distress and delayed the installation. The contractors said they weren't told we had cathedral ceilings. The salesperson spent nearly an hour inside our house and I did point out the cathedral ceilings.The contractors left a mess (broken glass on our driveway from an existing panel that was broken during removal, brick dust drilled for mounting of the new inverter), saying they would be back in a week! They also left the new panels and racking at our front door unsecured.We called Proven Energy and the manager came to secure the panels and told us he had rescheduled the install for the next day. He left the correct screws for the install with us.The contractors did completed the install the next day and cleaned up the mess, but only after I challenged them about leaving the mess. The response given about the mess was it is up to the homeowner to clean up! The install experience has left us concerned about the quality of the install.Proven Energy helped organise the grid connection very quickly after the installation.Our 12 year old PV array was damaged in a storm and we contacted the local company who had done the install to look at the array and advise on a replacement. They took 5 months and numerous follow up calls from us to provide  us with a quote. As a result of their lack of interest we came to SolarQuotes for assistance in finding a reliable and reputable local company to purchase our new array from.It is disappointing, annoying and frustrating that our installation experience did not go smoothly. Proven Energy has provided us with a handyman to do the repairs to our ceilings.We hope our relationship with Proven Energy will be supportive going forward.
Quotes were fairInstallation was excellent and professionalMishap with grid connections

We went to meet the people in their office and were impressed.  The installation went fine and so far it seems to be working.  It would have been good to have an instruction book and some simple explanations of the working parts and what to do if anything goes wrong.  This turn over part was very quickie and I still don’t have any written instructions or explanations of what the inverter signs are showing.  I was also left confused on what the internet connection was all about.  I think some thought should go into this so the average layman has an understanding of what he has purchased.

Proven Energy are a local Toowoomba company and this is why I chose them. Also they had good reviews. The sales team and installers were polite, friendly and professional. The installation went well however an issue with the type of system installed was rectified only a few days later. Overall I am happy with the service and installation provided by this company.
Sales quoting was easy and prompt. Had done their homework before they got to site. The installation went well and the grid connection was organised promptlywithout me having to get involved.
The whole process was handled very professionally.They dealt with all our questions very patiently.The staff were all very friendly.

From the initial quote through to installation, Proven Solar were very easy to deal with. Their service was excellent & their installation team left the work area clean & tidy. One of their biggest selling points for me was they’re a local Toowoomba company employing local tradesmen therefore keeping my dollars in the region & also they were easily contactable should I need to in the future. I’d highly recommend Proven Solar for all your solar needs.

The quoting process went very well.  Staff imparted a sense that this was a trustworthy company to deal with and someone we could rely on, even though they didn't actually verbalise such.  The installation went smooth and they didn't leave behind packaging contents for us to discard of.  We are really pleased with the service they provided and we would definitely go back to them, if and when, we need another solar system.

From the moment we first contacted Proven Energy to when the installers left we have been impressed with the professionalism of the company.Gabby’s knowledge of the systems was reassuring and the quotes were prompt. After site visits we had a good idea of what to expect.The installation team was prompt and efficient and obviously worked well together: by mid-afternoon the system was up and running and we’re more than happy with the result. The guys were happy to explain things as they worked.The whole process was seamless and we have no hesitation in recommending Proven Energy.

Sales and Quoting: Very Good, Friendly, knowledgeable, good listener, not pushy, no hard sellInstallation: Very good, Right on time, quick, very neat and tidy, very polite and considerateCustomer Service: Very Good

Proven Energy were great to deal with. the quoting prosses was very easy and detailed. the installation was great as well, very tidy and the workers were amazing. The customer service was 10 out of 10, I highly recommend Proven Energy! Gabby was just amazing to communicate with!

Gabby the sales is easy to deal with, all my questions were answered and not pushy with the sales. Had people come over for inspection to ensure a smooth installation. Very efficient, from quote to connect to grid and setting up wifi in less than 3 weeks. After sales care is good, unable to fault performance and workmanship. Very happy with their service.

Thank you so much for referring Proven Energy Solutions.We made contact with the three recommended providers.The one that stood out was Proven Energy Solutions. They contacted us the next day and came out to see us that week.Gabby at Proven Energy gave us a price that day and explained clearly what the installation would involve.We are happy to say that the owner Peter and his team Michael and Daryl did an excellent job installing our solar system.They came early in the morning and finished the entire installation by 12pm.I would highly recommend Proven Energy Solutions to any one.

Proven Energy was an excellent and reliable company to deal with. From the date of quotation to the final installation, I was informed of all the processes. They have been extremely helpful and a pleasure to deal with. They make the process extremely easy including completing all the necessary paperwork with the Energy Provider. Any questions were answered immediately and the team of installers and electrician were very professional and helpful.I would have no hesitation in recommending Proven Energy to any future customers due to reliability and quality of work.

From the moment I called Aiden from Proven Energy, I felt secure knowing he was forthright because I had done research on which companies to choose. They stayed in touch with me throughout the process, came and did two inspections of my house where measurements were taken, meter box prepared for the day and a general pre-checkup to make sure installation would go smoothly on the day. When it came time for installation, three men turned up and went straight to work, no dilly-dallying or mucking around. They were very professional and again explained the process to me. They went non-stop for six hours, ensuring the panels were attached to the roof securely and cleaned up any mess made, inside and outside the house because Peter also installed a new electric cooker for me. the following day, Peter returned for about two hours to get the inverter going and to ensure the cooker worked and the new hot water system was functioning well. I think it was the professionalism displayed that was best.

Excellent service from the Proven Energy sales person, who came to our home and clearly and patiently explained everything. The fact that the company was local weighed heavily on our decision, as the other companies who quoted just conducted telephone interviews from their offices and asked us to send them photos of our switchboard,The installers were punctual, efficient, fast, and well organised. They looked after the interaction with Ergon Energy, and made sure the Ergon representative completed the job as promised.

I was very happy with both sales and installation of my system.  Quotes were provided and questions answered without being bombarded with a heap of sales pitch.  I was able to do most of it via email which I preferred.Both the guys who came to measure the roof and the ones who installed it were polite and informative. I was a little worried when the installers mentioned putting some panels on my extension roof but they assured me it was the better spot and they wouldn’t be visible.  They were right (men being right, who knew!).  The installers left very little sign that they had been here.Proven Energy took care of getting the system connected up to the grid too.  Highly recommend these guys!

Pre-sales was professional, informative and timely. It made the decision to compare and decide between providers easy.The installation went as planned and on the day the team were polite and the leading hand made sure I was informed from the start through to the end. Clean-up was even very good.After sales service was good as well when there was technical issue with the Solar Web app for our power monitoring.I particularly appreciated the seamless move through the REC's and also getting the smart meter installed so that the system was fully functional. To be honest the hardest decision is committing to the capital outlay but the move to a large PV system with Proven is completely worthwhile.It was so much easier to deal with Proven compared to another company we used on a previous installation elsewhere.
Quote was informative. My visit to their office was informative and detailed.Instillation was on time, clean work, very professional people.Grid connection was organised for me.
Great service everything was arranged for us. They were not the cheapest quote however the customer service was excellent.I am using them to upgrade our hot water system as well.

The quoting process was timely and further questions were answered promptly so as to get an acuate quote comparisonInstallation was seemless and was completed without any issues and completed in a timely manner. Staff were helpful to rectify an issue with the inverter Wifi on commissioningWe are however still waiting an electrician to come out and inspect the timer for the hot water as its not working. I will be following this up this week for an update
Great personal service. Easy to contact when we had questions. Kept us up to date with progress.

When I got my electricity bill, I was irked at what it was costing me.  I knew I needed to do something about it but didn’t really know what I was doing when it came to solar.That’s where Proven Energy stepped in.  From the time I called to the finished job, fantastic service.  A consultant came around to my house, sat down and went through all the options in detail and painted a very clear picture of how a system works, went through options and even showed potential cost savings over a period of time for different sized systems. They even future proofed my system so I can add to it like batteries latter on if I wanted! Nothing was too hard.I found there were a lot of different products out there and Proven Energy were open and honest upfront about their experience with the efficiency and suitability of each. I found this fantastic because it allowed me to take control of the quality of my system and gave me confidence in what I was getting.Long story short, my last bill went from $460 to $31, the system will pay for itself in a few years and then every year after that, money in the pocket!
Proven Energy did a great job installing 6.4kw system for me, completing all the work in less then a single day with very tidy cabling. Looks and runs great from inverter to panel.
Very quick from quote to install, quick to answer any questions and tailor the quotes to what suits your needs.highly recommend.
Great service from first phone call to providing me with information and quotations. Install was done in good time and how I wanted it done. Very happy with system and performance great work.

I cannot praise the Proven team high enough.From first enquiry to installation, it has been a pleasant experience.I had a reply back, with 3 quotes with in 24 hrs.I was then phoned and more enquiries were made by them to ensure, that I was getting exactly what I required.They offered suggestions, I hadn't thought of.The bloke who came and did the measurements for the system was excellent, explained to me where the panels would be going, and why.When the installation blokes came out, they were polite, clean and effecient.Any questions were answered, no matter how inane,After the installation, everything about how the aircon works and the solar inverter works was explained to me.At no time was I left wondering when anything was taking place. I was contacted and kept informed by phone and by email every week from the initial quote to installation.I would recommend Proven Energy, especially if you live far from the maddening crowds, as I do.If Google can find you, they will to.
I was guided honestly throughout my choice process and to the final installation.

Sales and quoting process was very easy. My questions were all answered and additional advice provided regarding electrical services for water and aircon helped me to understand how it all comes together.The installation team was punctual and efficient. Got on with the job and tidied everything before leaving.Customer service was great. Very helpful and friendly from start to finish.I will use Proven Energy for additional electrical work as they were a pleasure to deal with.

I found the sales service to be prompt and friendly.  All my questions were answered in a timely manner.  The installation went well with the workers being polite and tidy.  The grid connection was organised, and am now eagerly awaiting my next bill!

We sought multiple quotes but Gabby was the only one who offered to come onsite and talk directly to us about the installation.The installation was quick and efficient and there was nothing really left for us to do but look at the power generation tool and watch the solar energy flow!Thanks :)

While not the cheapest, I chose to go with Proven due to their professionalism, commitment to service and willingness to answer many numerous questions. Paramount was willingness of staff to address any concerns I had. The system was installed effortlessly and on time, and when there was a minor issue that arose a few days later, the staff responded quickly and professionally to address my concerns. I am very happy with the system and service I received and am pleased to recommend Proven to any prospective buyer.

Troy and his team did a fantastic job organising for my storm damaged panels to be replaced with better quality ones. I am reassured in knowing that they will last me a long time and work most efficiently. Thank you everyone for looking after me.

Very satisfied with my solar system, installed April 2021 through Proven, didn't take long to see me energy bill come into credit with my electricity provider thanks to the correct configuration provided by salesman Aiden Wallace . All still looks well on the roof to after those few storms with hail passing through.Regards & Merry xmass to all @ Proven, JIM
Sales was good and happyWas very dissapointed in initial conduit finished workAfter speaking with Peter things were  sortedIan who come to commission was fantastic, a good asset to the company

The process was simple and informative. Proven Energy staff were quick to come out and quote, were knowledgeable, friendly and answered all my questions in easy to understand language.I didn't have to wait long for installation and it was done to the best standard possible, also considering the position and aesthetics of the system.I highly recommend Proven Energy.

The sales/quoting process was so simple and thorough. All questions were answered and explained  honestly. The quote was so much better than the out of town big name competition. For exactly the same system and panels.The instillation team were on time, cleaned up after themselves and paid great attention to detail.With progress calls before, and after install, I cannot fault their customer service.Proven energy organised everything from start to finish, including liaising with our power company and insuring every aspect was completed. We highly recommend Proven Energy

Proven came out immediately and gave us a great detailed qoute and plenty of helpful advice. Once we decided to go with them they were very fast at getting their team out to install. In and out with a very tidy system we are very pleased with our set-up. We especially like how we can track our energy usage and solar input on our phones. They did everything for us from start to finish even organised the change over with the electricity company no extra costs. They are very professional and know there stuff, highly recommended if you want great quality  and service for affordable pricing.

Peter and his team provided a prompt and responsive service from the beginning. Quote was  well explained and met our current and futureneeds.  Time from.orderimg to installation was as promised. Installation was smooth and team went extra mile in removing old unsafe system and leaving site clean and tidy. We needed a wifi booster and Peter went out of his way to make sure we got the right booster. Grid connection and web access manged by team. Overall we are very happy with product and services Proven Energy provided

- The quoting and sales process was second to none. Proven Energy came out to our property and checked the site and where the house was to confirm how they would believe best suited. They also pointed out that the system we originally were looking at would make no difference to a smaller system which I found extremely honest and made us feel comfortable that they weren't just in it for the money.- Instillation went well nothing was ever a problem and they were more than happy to discuss anything. Nothing was too small or too big (within reason) Everyone was very polite and easy to talk to.- Customer Service was exceptional as we didn't have internet there was a part of the system, we couldn't use yet and they were more than happy to come out when this was done and help us connect and understand how it worked.

Sales process was quick, easy and informative. No hard sell and pressure to sign up and gave good recommendations.We were kept updated with pre-installation activity.Installers turned up on time and when arranged - work quickly, politely and neatly, even with builders on site.Good information provided on the system and post sales has been great, with a number of follow up calls to make sure everything is ok and dealing with any issues without delay.Couldn’t recommend Proven Energy more!!

Sales and quoting was the decider in going with this company.Installation was prompt, efficient and the installers were competent and overall very nice people.I would thoroughly recommend this company and system to any potential customers.

I had a existing 6.5kw system already on the house, producing about 4900kw on a good day. And was looking at fitting another 6.5kw onthe house.  Proven sent there sales person out and inspected the house and the system, the first thing he suggested was to pull the existing system off the roof and install a10.5 kw. The existing system had a goodwee invertor and i did not know the what brand the panels where. The issures with the old system was that wires where touching the roof and the bottom outside panels where not properly supported. I was reluctant to remove the old system as i did not know how long it had been on , as i had only bought the house one month earlier.  After several discussions with Proven they would only come out and find out what brand of panels that where on the roof if i agreed to go with them. So i agreed and found out that they where jinko. After questioning the sales person i found that they had only been installed about two and half years ago. I was reluctant to throw it away, as selling it second hand would be difficult. So with the installer we agreed to fit it to my shed. The only problem is that i have 8 panels in the garage, because they would would not fit on the shed and i had paid a extra 2700 dollars for this work.. so we have paid about 14s000 dollars plus the 6000 rebate and thats what i am not happy with.

We have found Proven Energy very prompt , efficient and reliable.Their team has been courteous and informative from quote to installation. Nothing has been too much trouble, ensuring we have been given all the neccessary information to fully understand our system.We feel confident we've made the best choice in Proven Energy and wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.

Everything went well and the result was better than we expected.Great service and easy to deal with from start to finish.They even took time to show us how the mobile app worked, very impressive.Its been a few weeks now and already we are seeing the savings.Thanks Proven Energy for a great job. :)
Only company that came to my home, easy to talk to, happy to explain solar systems. Waiting on installation

These guys are knowledgeable and easy to deal with. There are plenty of solar companies out there and it's easy to get overwhelmed. Proven made it easy to understand and did not try and sell us anything we didn't need. Installation was fast, efficient and tidy. Go with these guys, you won't regret it.

I contacted each of the referrals. They were all courteous and knew their business. For the system we wanted, all three companies were ballpark in price. In the end, we could only choose one, and chose Proven Energy. Proven also arranged for our electricity supplier to connect the system to the grid.

Thank you Proven Energy for your recent installation of our 6.6kW solar system. We had a smooth and pleasant experience working with Proven Energy from the moment we contacted them.Our journey with Proven Energy began with an onsite visit from Aiden (sales advisor). We appreciated the time he took out to come out to our place and explained the basics of a solar system. He was honest and knowledgeable. We were very impressed with his honest advice and recommendations with respects to our needs and current situation. He did not try to push or upsell products that did not suit our current and future circumstances. His professional knowledge in the industry is to be commended. He was easily contactable after the initial on site visit to answer any questions I had.After extensive research and obtaining many quotes, we decided to go ahead with Proven Energy.The next part was the installation of the solar system. Troy from the office was able to organise a time that suited our busy schedules to fit in an onsite pre-installation inspection. We had Hamish come out to assess our roof space and provided us with reasons for his installation proposal. He was excellent in communicating his professional knowledge. We appreciated this pre-installation visit, as this gives us an opportunity to have time to consider and make decisions with regards to our installation. Many other companies I’ve talked to will just come out on the day of installation and make everything fit on the roof and leave. This was not the case with Proven Energy, and we appreciate this aspect of our journey with them.Installation day was organised and Hamish and his team turned up on time, as scheduled. Hamish and his team were professional and efficient. It was a neat and tidy installation. Utmost care was taken with the panel installation. There was no mess left on site after the installation. He clearly communicated the post-installation set up of the inverter, and returned the next day to install and set up the Wi-Fi monitoring device.We had no issues with the payment process and appreciated them promptly honouring the difference of the hot water meter that was not installed. We appreciated their honest advice that it would be more advantageous without the hot water meter, given our hot water boiler set up. Again, there was no upselling of product that did not suit our circumstances. They facilitated the connection to the grid with Ergon with no hassles or difficulties.We are particularly impressed with their honest communication and realistic expectations set out upfront. There were no “nasty surprises”. If we had a problem with our solar system in the future, I have no doubt that Proven Energy will be around and honour their installation guarantee.We are very happy customers and would not hesitate to recommend or work with Proven Energy again in the future!

Second to none, our overall experience from quote to installation was first rate.  Their communication style, professionalism, workmanship could not be faulted.  Their employees were friendly, well mannered, professional, tidy and knowledgeable. All safety precautions were adhered to during the installation process, in particular, those working at heights. Everything was organised for us, they took care of the grid installation.  This is our third home to which we have installed solar power and this by far, has been the best, certainly in terms of value for money, quality and knowledge of product and ease of installation. They exceeded our expectations in every way. Would absolutely recommend Proven Energy to anyone considering solar installation.

Aiden was great in his approach, understood that I was getting three quotes and did not pressure me.His quote wasn’t the cheapest, but I was satisfied I was getting quality components.I also prefer to deal local where practicalAs for the installation, they were excellent, went the extra mile in explaining what they were doingAnd did a fantastic job of all parts of the installCan’t wait for my next bill hahahThanks guys, great effort
More than happy with the quality of work done by the installer. They were helpful and friendly. It felt like a no nonsense installation.

From day one customer service was excellent, all questions answered in a professional manner. The sales person was patient and knowledgeable about all products. The installation was completed in a timely and tidy way.
Proven energy sales quoting installation and customer service were all excellent, would highly recommend to other people. 5 stars. Great knowledge of products, polite and very helpful

We could not have been happier with the service we received from Proven Energy for solar installation at our home. The process was smooth from start to finish. The sales team were prompt in making an appointment and providing us with a quote. We received thorough advice based on our needs and that of our home. We were regularly updated with when the products were due to arrive and when installation would take place. The team arrived on time on the day of installation and explained the process before starting. The staff were very clean and tidy and worked throughout the day until the job was complete. After sales service was spot on with follow up emails and phone calls. I would highly recommend Proven Energy as your solar installer!

From the initial consultation to the final installation nothing was too much trouble for the people from Proven Energy. The sales experience was pleasant and I did not feel pressured at any time. I was provided with three levels of quote and some honest advice about the differences between the quoted systems.The installation process was smooth even though the installation team encountered bad weather they returned promptly and completed the job at the first opportunity. The installation team were polite and kept me well informed at each stage of the job.All the paperwork was sorted for me with no further action required from me. On a point on customer service, the installation team even took down my old solar hot water system and took it away for disposal. I was very appreciative of that extra task they completed for me. As I said in the title nothing was too much trouble for Proven Energy.I would recommend them to others.
Proven Energy were a pleasure to deal with from start to finish. They provided a good schedule for delivery and installation and then came early and got the job done much quicker than expected.

This was my third solar install on several houses over a ten year period. My previous installer did not respond and proven energy for price, being local and customer service was a standout.Quoting process straight forward, not pushy and knowledgeable and flexible to change depending on customer requirements with 3 options provided initially.Our installation was slightly abnormal due to cable run to shed mounted solar involving external contractor trench digger. Time of year (christmas) and wet weather interrupted planned install day with the solar system installed over a few weeks.  There was two different teams of installers on both occasions and were very polite and performed a neat install. The main issue i observed was miscommunication about the job details between pre install inspector, office staff and installers. A good approach would be to use the same installer to follow through from pre inspect to job completion.I have and will continue to recommend to friends in Toowoomba that proven energy is a great option for solar in our region.

We received very professional customer service, with honest advice and quoting.  We received regular updates throughout the process and installation was completed without a hassle.  The tradesmen were polite, tidy and courteous.  We would definitely recommend Proven Energy.
Whole process was quick & easy. Installation went well and we’ve been happy with the results.

Great experience overall,l. I enquired during the silly season of December and they made sure someone could come out and have a look and provide us a quote.I had been told by another company that we needed 10kw but Proven assured us that would be overkill for our purpose. We ended up getting 6.6kw system and have had it for 3 months. Already seeing huge savings on our electricity bill.Highly recommend!
Proven Energy was awesome to deal with from the first call to the final inspection they were truly professional. The installation was very well done and they cleaned up perfectly. Thanks guys!

Proven Energy provided an excellent service and did everything as advertised. Communication was great and open and on going assistance at this stage anyway appears to be good as well. I’d recommend them again.

Great Sales Rep, explained everything and we thought what a great company.After paid deposit we were advised to expect phone call on Monday for install pre-check. When we had not heard by the following Friday we phoned office got a run around and finally a call from the owner, who came out the following week.The installation date and time was set.  The installers arrived at the stated time and date. When they arrived I introduced myself, however, neither installer gave a name. ( I know I am old school but manners are important).After installation the senior person gave me a brief run through of the operation procedure.
